about.label: ABOUT
about.title: What is Nostrasia?
about.lead1: Nostrasia is a Nostr conference, and a festival, that started in Japan. It has been held several times since the first edition in 2023, and the 2024 and 2025 editions took place in Tokyo. Talks, LTs, hands-on sessions, a market, the Nostr Shrine, a hero show and DJs: all kinds of people and all kinds of fun come together in one place.
about.lead2: Nostr is a decentralized protocol that doesn't rely on any particular company or server. You sign your posts with your own key and put them on relays around the world. Each piece is just a small shape, but put them together and they become a big bird: an ostrich. This site draws that idea with shapes.

how.label: NOSTR 101
how.title: New to Nostr?
how.lead: Keys are circles, relays are squares. In four steps, we build up how a Nostr post reaches people, using shapes.

1.name: Keys
1.title: Make your keys
1.body: First, you create a pair of keys: a secret key <c>nsec</c> and a public key <c>npub</c>. Your npub works as your name, and your nsec is the real key you never show anyone. There is no account sign-up.

2.name: Signature
2.title: Sign
2.body: When you write a post (a note, <c>kind:1</c>), you sign it (sig) with your secret key. Thanks to the signature, anyone can check that you really wrote it, wherever it ends up.

3.name: Relays ×3
3.title: Send it to relays
3.body: You send the signed post to several relays (the squares). A relay is just a relay point. Even if one goes down, the same post stays on the others.

4.name: Client
4.title: Read it in a client
4.body: A client (app) gathers posts from whichever relays you like and shows them. Even if you switch apps, you are still you as long as you have your key. You can also send a zap ⚡ to posts you like.
